summary: Assessment of task_29ad56cef72546479f1243eace8bb640 ("Finish OpenShell sandbox rollout: gateway standup + policies + enable + verify"). Also fixed a pre-existing test bug in tests/test_openshell_sandbox.py where test_invoke_sandboxed_runs_full_lifecycle failed on OpenShell-hosted agents because the coding-agent sandbox preflight probe injects a delete step into the patched _sandbox_step list before the expected lifecycle download step. Fix: add MAC_CODING_AGENT_SANDBOX=off monkeypatch to suppress the probe in that test. Recommendation: ESCALATE_TO_OPERATOR — task_29ad56 remains valid, all code is merged (PRs #134, #138-#141), remaining work is live host-side operator deployment that no fleet agent can perform.
